title: Canadian Food Prices Dashboard
description: Interactive dashboard for analyzing food price trends across Canadian provinces. Compare prices for bread, milk, and eggs over time, with options to view data in different currencies and units.
footer_info: Data source: Statistics Canada | Last updated: July 2025 | Interactive dashboard for educational and analytical purposes
provinces_description: Select one or more provinces to compare food prices across different regions of Canada.
food_type_description: Choose the specific food item you want to analyze. Each type has different pricing patterns and seasonal variations.
date_range_description: Select the time period for your analysis. Choose from 2020 to 2024 to see how prices have changed over time.
display_options_description: Customize how prices are displayed. Convert between currencies and change units for better comparison.
currency_description: Select the currency to display prices in. Convert between Canadian dollars, US dollars, and euros for international comparison.
view_mode_description: Choose how you want to visualize the data. Trends show price changes over time, while comparison shows current prices across food types.
trends_description: View how prices change over time for selected provinces and food types
comparison_description: Compare current prices across different food types in a selected province
bar_chart_date_description: Select the month and year to display the price comparison for that specific point in time.
bar_chart_province_description: Select the province to display in the bar chart. The line chart can show multiple provinces, but the bar chart only shows one.
both_description: Display both the price trends (line chart) and price comparison (bar chart) together.
no_data_message: No data available for {{date}} in {{province}}. Please adjust your filters or try another selection.
